exposure: Multidisciplinary team (MDT) approach to management of invasive placental disease (IPD)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 47 consecutive women with invasive placental disease (IPD) who underwent peripartum hysterectomies over a seven-year period.
finding: The multidisciplinary team (MDT) approach was associated with longer operative times but significantly less blood loss, fewer blood transfusions, and higher intraoperative mean arterial pressures compared to the No-MDT approach.
